
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/johnnyzen/p/19071140" title="发布于 2025-09-03 09:00">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">[Java/OracleJDK/OpenJDK] JDK厂商的识别与替换</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="0-序言">0 序言</h1>
<ul>
<li>jdk版本＞ oracle jdk 8u202，对于企业而言，将有知识产权风险。此时，建议使用低版本jdk，或者使用openjdk。</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>即 oracle jdk 8u202，无产权风险</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="1-概述-jdk的厂商">1 概述: Jdk的厂商</h1>
<h2 id="11-识别jdk的厂商">1.1 识别JDK的厂商</h2>
<h3 id="识别java命令的厂商">识别Java命令的厂商</h3>
<ul>
<li>方法1：要查看Java的厂商信息，可以通过命令行输入<code>java -version</code>，或者使用Java代码获取相关信息。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ java -version
java version "1.8.0_261"
Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_261-b12)
Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.261-b12, mixed mode)
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这将显示当前安装的Java版本和厂商信息。例如，如果输出中包含“<code>Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment</code>”，则表示这是由<code>Oracle</code>提供的JDK；如果是“<code>OpenJDK Runtime Environment</code>”，则表示是<code>OpenJDK</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>方法2</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ java -XshowSettings:properties -version
  java.runtime.name = Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment
  java.runtime.version = 1.8.0_261-b12
  java.specification.name = Java Platform API Specification
  java.specification.vendor = Oracle Corporation
  java.specification.version = 1.8
  java.vendor = Oracle Corporation
  java.vendor.url = http://java.oracle.com/
  java.vm.name = Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM
  java.vm.specification.vendor = Oracle Corporation
  java.vm.specification.version = 1.8
  java.vm.vendor = Oracle Corporation
</code></pre>
<h3 id="查看指定java进程的厂商">查看指定Java进程的厂商</h3>
<ul>
<li>方法1</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># jps -l
# jcmd {pid} PerfCounter.print
  ...
  java.property.java.vm.specification.vendor="Oracle Corporation"
  java.property.java.vm.vendor="Oracle Corporation"
  ...
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>方法2</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># jps -l
# jcmd {pid} VM.system_properties
  java.vm.specification.vendor=Oracle Corporation
  java.specification.vendor=Oracle Corporation
  ...
  #java.home=D\:\\Program\\IDEA\\IDEA_COMMUNITY 2022.2\\jbr
  #java.home=D\:\\Program\\Java\\jdk-17.0.7
</code></pre>
<h2 id="12-openjdk-的获取">1.2 OpenJDK 的获取</h2>
<ul>
<li>OpenJDK 官网</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://openjdk.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://openjdk.org/</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/openjdk/jdk" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openjdk/jdk</a> (支持 jdk9 及之后的 源码和jdk包的获取)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>微软官网</li>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download</a></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://adoptium.net/zh-CN/temurin/releases?version=8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://adoptium.net/zh-CN/temurin/releases?version=8</a> (支持获取 openjdk8 的安装包，微软官方链接至此)</li>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-8</a> √</li>
<li><a href="https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=8</a> √ (微软官方链接至此)</li>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-11" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-11</a> √</li>
<li><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-17" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/java/openjdk/download#openjdk-17</a> √</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Docker 镜像:</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>docker-release/docker.io/library/eclipse-temurin:8-jdk-alpine</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="13-基于java构建的常用软件">1.3 基于Java构建的常用软件</h2>
<h3 id="idea">IDEA</h3>
<ul>
<li>IDEA 【软件本身】是 openjdk，但IDEA中开发者给【项目工程】配置的 jdk，要单独检查。</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>IDEA 内置的 jdk，默认是使用 openjdk</p>
<blockquote>
<p>如: <code>java.home=D\:\\Program\\IDEA\\IDEA_COMMUNITY 2022.2\\jbr</code></p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="dbeaver">DBeaver</h3>
<ul>
<li>DBVeaver 依赖的jdk，需用户自行配置</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>如 java.home=D:\Program\Java\jdk-17.0.7</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>修改DBeaver设置的JDK</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>D:\Program\DBeaver-23-0-4\dbeaver\dbeaver.ini</code> :</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bat">-vm
D:\Program\Java\openjdk17\jdk-17.0.16+8\bin\javaw.exe
-vmargs
-XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions
-Dosgi.requiredJavaVersion=17
--add-modules=ALL-SYSTEM
--add-opens=java.base/java.io=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.lang.reflect=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.net=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.nio=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.nio.charset=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.text=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.time=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.util.concurrent=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/java.util.concurrent.atomic=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.vm=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/sun.nio.ch=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/sun.security.ssl=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/sun.security.action=ALL-UNNAMED
--add-opens=java.base/sun.security.util=ALL-UNNAMED
-Xms64m
-Xmx1024m
-Ddbeaver.distribution.type=zip
</code></pre>
